card.name: Sentence ends in biographical or narrative prose
card.fires_on: Sentence-ending periods, closing quote marks, semicolons, or a joining 'and' after a complete statement in general narrative or biographical text. It marks the point where a new sentence or clause is about to begin.

modes.label: Period after a full statement
modes.description: A period ends a sentence about a person, place or event, and a new sentence follows.

modes.description: A semicolon or 'and' joins a second clause about another person after the first has ended.

card.writes: It favors sentence openers such as 'After', 'Following' and 'Although', and disfavors linking adverbs like 'meanwhile' and 'similarly'.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a sentence in story-like text, just before the next sentence starts.
